scope: Full tracked checkout; targeted static bodies and selected assertion review of models/readiness, live-route binding, ingestion and workspace aggregation, triage/plan and metric/cache admission, native editor writes and refresh recovery, watcher/snapshot generations, sprint/ETA/risk, static export and preview, and selected correlation/search boundaries. Not every-line, complete numerical/engine/cache/installer/deployment/browser/runtime certification.

lifecycle_review.create: Task creation external to viewer; reads rich issue snapshots from JSONL/SQLite and attaches verified live tracker origin separately; native sprint writer helper has no production caller beyond own delegation in inspected call inventory
lifecycle_review.select: Full-source readiness distinct from metric graph/candidate scope; missing references and hierarchy cycles unknown; ready includes ongoing work, claimable excludes assignment/epic/open children; triage partial source and native route guards; metric gate specifically PageRank/betweenness
lifecycle_review.claim: Generates routed literal argv for br/bd update --claim when installed help advertises support; no reservation or attempt token; tracker must recheck authority at execution
lifecycle_review.progress: TUI editor revalidates source/session/metadata and native issue via show, then separate unconditional update; no if-unchanged flag, so preflight/write race remains; descriptive progress and comments imported rather than native handoff protocol
lifecycle_review.review: Acceptance/review state displayed; source hashes and confidence-bearing correlation help investigation but no qualified review authority, result evidence pin or acceptance transition
lifecycle_review.complete: Task close delegated to installed tracker; viewer does not enforce child result acceptance or stop workers; graph what-if completion and track groups are analytical only
lifecycle_review.cancel: Command context cancels viewer subprocess wait and background analysis; possible committed tracker outcome remains inspectable; no worker/task execution cancellation or external effect compensation
lifecycle_review.recover: Last-good snapshots and generation-gated publication, watcher fallback and coalescing; draft retained after failed save and committed-save/export gap; export-only retry; abandoned-claim alerts heuristic not task lease/reclaim; independent stores lack shared online ownership
